_comment: The field DocOga plays on — verified by web research on 2 Nov 2026 (docs/COMPETITOR_WATCH.md). tools/competitor_watch.py reads the public feeds here every Monday (₦0: RSS, sitemaps, YouTube channel feeds; nothing that needs a login) and hands the brain what the field published, so every DocOga post is written knowing what the others said — to say it better, cite the section they did not, and take the angle they missed. Never to copy. Add a competitor only with a source you read; never a guess.

competitors.name: NigeriaBuildingCost — tenancy agreement generator
competitors.note: Free generator, 36 states + FCT, printed copy watermarked; ₦4,000 one-time pass removes watermarks on all six tools for 90 days (site, read 2 Nov 2026). Closest direct rival to the pass model.

competitors.name: Wonder.Legal Nigeria
competitors.note: Questionnaire templates incl. a free basic rent receipt and 14 housing letters (notice to quit, late rent, deposit return); Word + PDF; revision-dated.

competitors.name: DIYLaw
competitors.note: Paid per document, Nigeria-drafted tenancy agreement; direct-to-purchase.

competitors.name: SabiLaw Solutions
competitors.note: Lawyer-prepared Word template, one-time purchase, instant download.

competitors.name: Legalnaija templates
competitors.note: Short questionnaire → paid download; also a legal-information blog with steady tenancy posts.

competitors.name: Rently.ng
competitors.note: Landlord SaaS: payment ledger with one-click PDF receipts, agreement generator + e-sign on the paid plan, tenant portal, WhatsApp/SMS reminders.

competitors.name: Homz.ng
competitors.note: Property-management dashboard that generates agreements, quit notices and receipts; subscription.

competitors.name: Mushrooms.ng blog
competitors.note: The strongest 2026 explainers on renting in Lagos (fee stack, the 2026 Tenancy Bill explained, scripts to negotiate agents) — SEO competitor for every 'Lagos rent' query.

competitors.name: Lexpraxis Solicitors blog
competitors.note: Law-firm explainers (the Tenancy Bill 2025 clause by clause, Aug 2026).

competitors.name: Olamide Oyetayo Legal
competitors.note: Landlord-side eviction explainers (Recovery of Premises Act, Lagos Tenancy Law) feeding a legal-services funnel.

competitors.name: AALAWSNG — Adeola Kolawole (YouTube)
competitors.note: Law-talk videos on notice to quit; long-form, lawyer-to-camera. Channel feed to be added once its channel id is read from the page. One 2022 explainer on notice to quit; low activity — watched via the channel feed when the page names it.

competitors.name: @legalfriendng — Real Estate Lawyer (TikTok)
competitors.note: Reacts to viral tenant stories with the Lagos Tenancy Law section (ss.6–7 on improvements, Oct 2026). TikTok has no public feed at ₦0 — watched by hand, not by the machine.

competitors.name: @talk360law — KING, ESQ. (TikTok)
competitors.note: Benin-based lawyer; 'lawyer reacts' format on tenant stories (788 likes / 183 comments on one, Oct 2026). No public feed at ₦0.

competitors.name: @theonlybusayoadesanya (TikTok)
competitors.note: Lawyer; quit-notice timing videos picked up by Legit.ng (Sep 2025). No public feed at ₦0.
